def VTask.binaryRec : {motive : ℕ → Sort u} → (zero : motive 0) → (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) → (n : ℕ) → motive n
  := fun {motive} zero bit n =>
    have h : ∀ (n : ℕ), motive n := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h n ih =>
        match n with
        | 0 =>
          exact zero
        | n + 1 =>
          have h₁ : n + 1 = Nat.bit (Nat.testBit (n + 1) 0) (n + 1 >>> 1) := by
            have h₂ : (n + 1) = Nat.bit (Nat.testBit (n + 1) 0) (n + 1 >>> 1) := by
              rw [Nat.bit_testBit]
              <;> simp [Nat.div_eq_of_lt]
              <;>
              (try omega) <;>
              (try
                {
                  have h₃ : (n + 1) >>> 1 < n + 1 := by
                    apply Nat.div_lt_self
                    <;> omega
                  omega
                })
            exact h₂
          rw [h₁]
          apply bit (Nat.testBit (n + 1) 0) (n + 1 >>> 1)
          have h₂ : (n + 1 >>> 1) < n + 1 := by
            apply Nat.div_lt_self
            <;> omega
          have h₃ : motive (n + 1 >>> 1) := ih (n + 1 >>> 1) h₂
          exact h₃
    h n
